Arrows move  Enter reset  B back

scripts.render:
local s = ctx.sceneState
local function isWall(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x > 7 or y < 0 or y > 7 then return true end
    if x == 0 or x == 7 or y == 0 or y == 7 then return true end
    if (x == 2 and y == 2) or (x == 3 and y == 2) or (x == 4 and y == 2) then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 3 then return true end
    if (x == 1 and y == 4) or (x == 2 and y == 4) then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 5 then return true end
    if (x == 5 and y == 6) or (x == 6 and y == 6) then return true end
    return false
end
local g1x, g1y = 3, 1
local g2x, g2y = 2, 5
local str = ""
for y = 0, 7 do
    for x = 0, 7 do
        if x == s.px and y == s.py then
            str = str .. "@"
        elseif (x == s.c1x and y == s.c1y) or (x == s.c2x and y == s.c2y) then
            str = str .. "O"
        elseif isWall(x, y) then
            str = str .. "#"
        elseif (x == g1x and y == g1y) or (x == g2x and y == g2y) then
            str = str .. "."
        else
            str = str .. " "
        end
    end
    if y < 7 then str = str .. "\n" end
end
s.board_text = str
scripts.move:
local s = ctx.sceneState
local function isWall(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x > 7 or y < 0 or y > 7 then return true end
    if x == 0 or x == 7 or y == 0 or y == 7 then return true end
    if (x == 2 and y == 2) or (x == 3 and y == 2) or (x == 4 and y == 2) then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 3 then return true end
    if (x == 1 and y == 4) or (x == 2 and y == 4) then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 5 then return true end
    if (x == 5 and y == 6) or (x == 6 and y == 6) then return true end
    return false
end

local nx = s.px + s.dx
local ny = s.py + s.dy
if not isWall(nx, ny) then
    if nx == s.c1x and ny == s.c1y then
        local nnx = nx + s.dx
        local nny = ny + s.dy
        if not isWall(nnx, nny) and not (nnx == s.c2x and nny == s.c2y) then
            s.c1x = nnx
            s.c1y = nny
            s.px = nx
            s.py = ny
        end
    elseif nx == s.c2x and ny == s.c2y then
        local nnx = nx + s.dx
        local nny = ny + s.dy
        if not isWall(nnx, nny) and not (nnx == s.c1x and nny == s.c1y) then
            s.c2x = nnx
            s.c2y = nny
            s.px = nx
            s.py = ny
        end
    else
        s.px = nx
        s.py = ny
    end
end

local g1x, g1y = 3, 1
local g2x, g2y = 2, 5
local c1OnGoal = (s.c1x == g1x and s.c1y == g1y) or (s.c1x == g2x and s.c1y == g2y)
local c2OnGoal = (s.c2x == g1x and s.c2y == g1y) or (s.c2x == g2x and s.c2y == g2y)
s.win = c1OnGoal and c2OnGoal

local str = ""
for y = 0, 7 do
    for x = 0, 7 do
        if x == s.px and y == s.py then
            str = str .. "@"
        elseif (x == s.c1x and y == s.c1y) or (x == s.c2x and y == s.c2y) then
            str = str .. "O"
        elseif isWall(x, y) then
            str = str .. "#"
        elseif (x == g1x and y == g1y) or (x == g2x and y == g2y) then
            str = str .. "."
        else
            str = str .. " "
        end
    end
    if y < 7 then str = str .. "\n" end
end
s.board_text = str
